narrative: Urgent chat claiming your cloud backup storage will be deleted in 10 minutes.

message.body: CRITICAL: CloudDrive storage quota exceeded. 2.4 GB of personal photos will be PERMANENTLY DELETED in 10 minutes. Upgrade storage immediately at http://clouddrive-upgrade-now.com

evidence.label: Payment Request
evidence.value: Requires entering credit card details on unencrypted page

evidence.label: CloudDrive App Settings
evidence.value: App settings shows 45 GB available of 100 GB quota.

consequence_text.safe: You opened your CloudDrive app settings and saw plenty of free storage remaining.
consequence_text.unsafe: Panic-buying storage on suspicious links leads to credit card fraud.

teaching_point: Check cloud storage quotas inside the official app settings when threatened with deletion.
